notesHint: Say each word out loud as it lands. The last word is the promise of the talk.
description_en: The title splits into two to five words that relay across the stage; the final word stays and a centre wipe closes the scene.
description_ko: 제목을 2~5개 단어로 쪼개 차례로 화면을 가로지르고, 마지막 단어만 남긴 뒤 가운데 와이프로 장면을 닫는다.
responsive: At widths up to 720px, display each word on its own centered row and keep the progress rail below the phrase.
reducedMotion: Show the full arrow-separated phrase and complete progress rail as a static composition.
purpose: 제목을 2~5개 단어로 쪼개 차례로 화면을 가로지르고, 마지막 단어만 남긴 뒤 가운데 와이프로 장면을 닫는다.
